note: One row per trial. Paper edits this file when a trial starts, is judged, wins, or is killed. 'live' keys are filled in by scripts/scoreboard.py at render time.

experiments.name: Momentum crypto v2 (BTC 50% core + top-2 alts) vs old top-4
experiments.hypothesis: A 50% BTC core plus the top 2 momentum alts beats the old equal top-4 momentum book.
experiments.rule: Revert if v2 trails the old book by more than 2 pts.

experiments.name: Relative-strength alt filter
experiments.hypothesis: An alt keeps its 15% slot only if its 63d return beats BTC's; otherwise the slot goes to BTC.
experiments.rule: Promote if it leads v2 by more than 1.5 pts with no more than 2 pts extra drawdown; kill if it trails by more than 1 pt or never diverges.

experiments.name: Mean-reversion equity satellite (up to 10%)
experiments.hypothesis: A weekly bottom-8 mean-reversion satellite adds return without adding drawdown.
experiments.result_text: Backtest 10/26: mean reversion +17.57% 1y (DD -6.53%) vs live monthly momentum -0.18% (DD -11.06%). Led every method for a fourth Monday. Turnover 10.9x.
experiments.rule: Fund up to 10% of equity out of the 11/02 monthly rebalance if it still leads.

experiments.name: Weekly shadow book vs monthly live equity
experiments.hypothesis: Monthly rebalancing does as well as weekly with less turnover.
experiments.control: Weekly 63d momentum + top-10 buffer, simulated, never booked
experiments.rule: Revert to weekly if live trails the shadow by more than 1.5 pts or adds more than 1 pt drawdown over the 4 monthly rebalances 11/02 to 02/01. First judge 11/02.
